Summary: Speaking one language, people settled at Shinar and began building a city and a tower to reach the heavens and make a name for themselves. God confused their language and scattered them over the earth, halting the proud project.
Significance: Babel shows what human pride builds, and Pentecost will one day show what God's Spirit gathers. Our hope is not in making our own name great, but in the God who brings scattered people together in Christ.
